title: Paranormal investigators to take over historic North Yorkshire school after dark
excerpt: Ghost hunters will explore the former Saltburn Primary School after dark during a five-hour paranormal investigation this December.
content:
A historic North Yorkshire school is opening its doors after dark for a late-night ghost hunt this December.

Kindred Spirit Investigations will host the paranormal investigation at the former Saltburn Primary School building on Marske Mill Lane, with guests exploring its old rooms and corridors until the early hours of the morning.

The event runs from 9pm to 2am on Saturday, December 5, and is billed as a hands-on investigation rather than a traditional ghost tour.

Guests will use professional ghost-hunting equipment alongside the Kindred Spirit Investigations team as they explore the historic building.

Visitors and investigators have reported unexplained activity at the site, including footsteps, bangs, taps, clicking doors and the feeling of being watched.

Saltburn Old School on Marske Mill Lane (Image: Google)

The Grade II-listed school building dates from 1903 and was originally built as a girls' high school before later becoming a primary school.

Its distinctive red brickwork, stone detailing and domed cupola remain, topped by a dolphin weather vane above the former school hall.

Generations of children passed through its classrooms when the Marske Mill Lane building became one of the sites used by Saltburn Primary School.

The town’s education plans changed significantly during the 2000s.

In 2007, The Northern Echo reported on proposals for a new £16m Saltburn Learning Campus, bringing together a replacement for Huntcliff School and a new primary school to replace Saltburn Primary's Marske Mill Lane and Upleatham Street sites.

The historic building was subsequently given a new lease of life.

Today, the former school is home to The Earthbeat Centre and has continued to find new uses while retaining much of its historic character.

But on December 5, attention will turn to what its old classrooms and corridors are like once darkness falls.

Kindred Spirit Investigations says guests will explore the building’s “darkest corners and most active areas” during the five-hour investigation.

Places for the event can be secured with a £10 deposit, with the remaining balance due one month beforehand.

For more information, visit the Kindred Spirit Investigations website.
